head: e5f7012b01131c417aa8be4cdb9a48d2eb6ef605
reviewScope: Workspace resolver, dependency-index builder and classification, tsconfig collector, filesystem read/realpath/glob adapters and glob backend selection. Other exports and schema internals are not exhaustively reviewed.
findings: Workspace discovery reads root workspace patterns and rejects empty/absolute/parent-traversal patterns; canonical workspace paths must remain inside the canonical root.

Directory population, symlinks, canonical paths, manifest content and read success affect the discovered workspace map. Duplicate package names overwrite the earlier map entry; no duplicate-name rejection is shown in the reviewed resolver.

FsUtils readJson maps all read failures to NoSuchFileError. Child discovery and dependency-index reads skip this tag, so skipped entries cannot be assumed to mean absent files alone. Parse/decode failures instead fail the operation.

Dependency classification covers dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies and optionalDependencies; membership in the discovered workspace-name set decides internal versus npm, not the version prefix alone. Root has the synthetic @beep/root key.
Tsconfig discovery scans tsconfig*.json at root and each workspace with absolute results; ignores ci-runners/sdks; absent matches omit the map entry.

SharedGlob selects Bun.Glob when globalThis.Bun.Glob exists; otherwise it uses the Node/picomatch scanner. Both finalize deduplicated string-sorted paths. Node skips missing entries and does not recurse through symlinked child directories. This review does not prove all backend behavior equivalent.
Repeated discovery/manifest reads are not a filesystem snapshot. Mutation between reads remains a concurrency input and is not closed by stable fixture tests.

tests.rootGlobSelectionMeaning: No test files found; corrected by running the suite from the package directory.

remaining: Full schema, formatter/docgen and graph helper closure remains incomplete.
Runtime and filesystem perturbation matrix, signed remote evidence and real pilot qualification remain required.
